officialDefaults.policy: Preserve the official shadcn Base UI Nova default classes, semantic tokens, variants, composition, and behavior. Apply only the compatibility adjustments identified below; do not redesign, retheme, or substitute project-specific visuals.

excludedComponents.reason: The official component depends on cmdk 1.1.1, whose current peer contract requires React and ReactDOM 18 or 19. Replacing cmdk or copying its behavior would not be a narrow compatibility adjustment.

The official component depends on @shadcn/react 0.3.0, whose current peer contract requires React 19 or newer and @types/react 19 or newer. Reimplementing the headless behavior would be a substitution.

The official component currently resolves react-resizable-panels 4.12.2, whose peer contract requires React and ReactDOM 18 or 19. Pinning an older release would change the current official dependency and API.

documentedCompositions.reason: The official catalog documents a composition recipe, but the official Base UI Nova registry has no data-table item. The package documents the composition and does not invent a public component export.

explicitDivergences.summary: Bind generated JSX to the shared React 17 namespace without changing rendered markup or official classes.
Use React 17-compatible ref-bearing public wrapper types without changing runtime behavior.
Prefix official utility classes and compile them into the profile stylesheet so they cannot affect the SharePoint host.
Scope the official semantic token names to the owned UI root while retaining their Base Nova values and meanings.
Route overlay portals to the owning SPFx UI host without changing official overlay styling or interaction behavior.
Derive generated IDs from the owning SPFx UI host to keep concurrent React 17 roots isolated.
Apply reviewed, version-bound Base UI declaration, popup lifecycle, and ID ownership compatibility transforms.
Resolve the official react-day-picker@latest metadata declaration only to the reviewed react-day-picker 10.0.1 package and its integrity-bound production closure.

Retain the official Navigation Menu easing-[ease], data-activation-direction=*, and xs:* class literals verbatim even though Tailwind 4.3.3 emits none of them with the official default theme, preserving the official runtime result while making every non-emitting candidate explicit.
Replace the official module-global toast manager with a host-local default manager and explicit createToastManager adapter so independent SPFx roots cannot share toast state.
